regulation.ioss_oss_summary: OSS allows EU-established sellers to declare all intra-EU B2C distance sales in a single quarterly return; IOSS covers VAT collection at checkout on imported B2C goods up to EUR 150, avoiding customs delays.
regulation.reach_summary: Regulation (EC) 1907/2006 (REACH) restricts hazardous substances in furniture finishes, adhesives, foams and textiles; sellers must ensure suppliers comply with SVHC notification and Annex XVII restrictions.
regulation.en1335_summary: EN 1335-1:2020+A1:2022 defines dimensions and chair types (Ax, A, B, C); EN 1335-2:2018 and EN 1335-3 set safety, strength and durability requirements for office work chairs used 8h/day up to 110 kg.
regulation.ce_lighting_summary: Electrical lamps placed on the EU market require CE marking under the Low Voltage Directive 2014/35/EU, EMC Directive 2014/30/EU, RoHS 2011/65/EU and Ecodesign/EPREL energy labelling (Reg. 2019/2020).
regulation.gdpr_summary: Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) requires lawful basis for processing, transparent privacy notices, consent for marketing cookies (ePrivacy), DPA with processors, and breach notification within 72h.
regulation.source_regulation: EU Commission VAT One Stop Shop portal; ECHA REACH; CEN EN 1335 series; EUR-Lex Directives 2014/35/EU, 2014/30/EU, 2011/65/EU; Regulation (EU) 2016/679

banking_kyc.dropshipping_risk_classification: Dropshipping is consistently classified as high-risk by EU banks and EMIs due to chargeback exposure, fulfilment delays, cross-border flows and AML concerns; onboarding is typically faster with EMIs licensed by Bank of Lithuania or similar regulators than with tier-1 banks.
typical_kyc_requirements: Certificate of incorporation, articles of association and ONRC registry extract for the Romanian SRL
UBO declaration and ID/proof of address for all 25%+ beneficial owners and directors
Detailed business model description with supplier agreements and sample invoices
Website URL with compliant T&Cs, refund/return policy, privacy policy and imprint
Expected monthly turnover, AOV, target markets and processing history (chargeback ratio)
Source of funds / source of wealth documentation for shareholders
Proof of VAT/OSS registration and tax residency
Ongoing transaction monitoring and enhanced due diligence per PSD2 and AMLD6
